title: chat-types: type broadcast scope vocab before 0.4
description: Freeze blocker from the fourth 2026-10-21 freeze review. JMAP-do5p (5c1c0a20) retyped five vocab fields but missed the broadcast-scope vocabulary, still String at HEAD c59916d8: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs:293 BroadcastMention.scope String; rich.rs:113 Span.scope Option<String> (broadcast span); push.rs:134 ChatMessagePush.mention_scopes Option<Vec<String>> (and the constructor arg at push.rs:318). Spec 6bcd9d8 closes the set: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00 L188 'Each element is one of "everyone", "here", or "admins" as defined by the BroadcastMention type'; federation-00 L439 rejects any other scope. The message.rs:289-292 doc keeps String for forward-compat, which impl_string_enum! Other(String) already provides. Changing these pub field types after 0.4 breaks semver. Per Mark's 2026-10-20 lrgt.7 decision (retype via impl_string_enum!), add a BroadcastScope enum and retype all three, or record an explicit decision to freeze them as String.
